content: General blog/community consensus (not project-specific) recommends HikariCP minimum-idle=5, connection-timeout=30000, idle-timeout=600000, max-lifetime=1800000, keepalive-time=300000 for a generic local Postgres app -- these are generic defaults, not validated against this repo's actual low-traffic shape or HikariCP source, and should not be copied uncritically (this repo's own convention is to verify against HikariCP source, not blog defaults).
